details:
Q1: How should group 0 be brought back under budget, given that every other `orchestrate-poll` group and every `tests-*` job is already near 15 minutes?
Choices:
A) Move only: send the step `Unblock judge, scan and orphan fix-up close tests (replace-claude-sessions Phase 7)` (or the fast-fail subset) to whichever group or job the planner estimates has the most room, name and body unchanged. This follows the issue's wording, but it will probably trigger another budget-watch issue for the receiving job.
B) Change the `orchestrate-poll` matrix from 4 to 5 groups. Each group's slice of the sharded poll module gets smaller, and group 0 keeps its current steps. The required check is still only the aggregate `CI / lint`, which already depends on the whole `orchestrate-poll` matrix, so no new required job name appears; the sharding contract tests would be updated to match. (RECOMMENDED)
C) Do both: add the fifth group and give it the unblock step, so group 0 keeps only its slice plus the fast-fail subset.
